title: Flattening commutes with aligned zipping
statement: Let $L_1$ and $L_2$ be lists of lists, with entries in types $\alpha$ and $\beta$, respectively. If the two outer lists have equal length and their entries have equal lengths at every corresponding index, then zipping the flattened lists gives the same list as zipping corresponding inner lists and flattening the result.
